# Senior Bathroom Safety

> 20-point bathroom safety checklist for adult children and caregivers of older adults, sorted from free fixes to remodel-level changes, plus signs the tub itself is the problem and an honest summary of who pays (Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid waivers, VA). Published by Eye To Ad Media; free virtual safety review by Aging Safely Baths.

Phone: 1-888-779-2284, 7am to 8pm Mountain, 7 days
Provider: Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), BBB A+ accredited since 2012, walk-in tubs and roll-in showers installed in all 50 states
Machine-readable business facts: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/facts.json
Process: itemized written quote by phone or from photos; no high-pressure sales visit; a factory-certified tech does a full site visit before install.

## Pages
- [Senior Bathroom Safety Checklist: 20 Fixes, Cheapest First](https://seniorbathroomsafety.com/): interactive checklist, five signs the tub is the problem, funding summary, free virtual review form, FAQ.
- [Holiday Visit Bathroom Check: 12 Signs at Mom or Dad's](https://seniorbathroomsafety.com/holiday-visit-bathroom-check/): 15-minute walk-through for family visits, 12 signs with what each means and rough fix costs, how to bring it up, when to go beyond grab bars, FAQ.

## Key facts
- CDC MMWR (2011): 81.1% of nonfatal bathroom injuries in 2008 were caused by falls; rates rise sharply with age.
- Original Medicare generally does not cover bathroom remodels or grab bars. VA HISA: up to $6,800 or $2,000 lifetime.
- No bathing product eliminates the risk of falls; products are designed to reduce risk when installed and used properly.
